fields.label: Free stock check
fields.description: Block: a Purchase Material Request may only ask for what free stock can't cover. Warn: show the free stock but allow submitting. Off: no check.

fields.label: Roles that may override
fields.description: Users with any of these roles can submit anyway by filling in an override reason on the Material Request.

fields.label: How it works
fields.options: On submit, each batch-tracked item on a Purchase Material Request is compared with stock of that item free to reserve right now (in stores, not reserved, not produced for another project). The request may ask for at most requested − free. Reserve the free stock for the project on the Stock Reservation page first; it then stops counting as free.
